# John Korede — Software Developer

John Korede is a Software Developer and Computer Science graduate from Caleb University (Second Class Upper Honors). He specializes in full-stack web application development, backend systems, and automated workflow tooling.

## Primary Focus Areas
- Full-Stack Web Development (React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS)
- Backend API Architecture & Authentication (REST APIs, JWT, Role-Based Access Control)
- Workflow Automation (Google Apps Script, Google Workspace APIs, Google Sheets)

## Key Projects
- Rentra: Full-stack property management platform for property owners and tenants.
- Learnova: Full-stack learning management platform featuring course workflows, assessments, and deterministic rule-based adaptive learning (non-AI/ML).
- FinTrack: MERN personal finance tracking platform with transaction management and financial dashboards.
- Property Management Automation: Workflow automation tool built with Google Apps Script and Google Sheets for recurring rent notifications.
